reader.requirement: For a relative file open I-O with RANDOM or DYNAMIC access, WRITE must insert the record area's content at the relative record number the program placed in the RELATIVE KEY item (not at a sequential number), leave the key item as the program set it, and refuse an occupied slot (22) or an out-of-boundary number (24 at 1985, per GR14/GR15 and VIII.1.3.4) with the record area unaffected.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehaviors.IsActive(DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError, Edition) (active from 2014): a random/dynamic key < 1 or > int.MaxValue answers '34' permanent error from 2014, '24' invalid key below it
stores the compiled edition on the connector (FileConnector.Edition) that the gate above reads
InForce (Edition.Year < 2002): §1985:VIII.4.9.3 SR3 requires INVALID KEY or an applicable USE on a relative WRITE (COBOL6826); not part of GR13's semantics

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehavior|Edition|CobolVersion over RelativeConnector.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs write path and KeyedIoEmitter.cs (KeyedIoEmitter consults none).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only the out-of-range key (0) differs: 24 invalid key at 85, 34 permanent error (sticky) at 2023; the insertion itself is the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers DYNAMIC access into empty slots only; RANDOM access, a COMP key item, a duplicate slot, key 0 and the largest key value are not exercised

reader.notes: KeyedIoEmitter.EmitWrite stages the RELATIVE KEY value through FileSetRelativeKey for random/dynamic access and does not move a number back (only the sequential arm does); RelativeConnector.Write takes _pendingKey as the slot. The one edition arm (key out of range) takes the 1985 '24'.
reader.at-2023: same insertion behaviour; key 0 answers 34 instead of 24

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-030: rfpi.cob (DYNAMIC I-O: WRITE 2 -> 00 key 002; DELETE 5 then WRITE 5 -> 00, READ NEXT gives NEW005: a vacated slot is not 'a record which already exists'); rbig.cob (RANDOM I-O, PIC 9(10) COMP-3 key: 2147483647 -> 00 and read back BIG1, 2147483648 -> INVALID KEY 24 with key and record area unchanged, RBIG.REL 28 KB so the store is sparse); rlock.cob (WRITE ... WITH NO LOCK, a 2002 phrase, refused at 85: COBOL0900). RelativeConnector.Write takes _pendingKey as the slot; the only edition switch on the random arm is RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError (24 below 2014), which the reader listed. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR13 'records are to be inserted in the associated file'; OK §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR14; OK §1985:VIII.1.3.4 (GRL2.3c, status 24).
